SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS, part of CHRISTIAN in PP2 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why do we go to church?
